_comment: A token/cost account: `spend` carries real money, so the usage view auto-detects Cost mode. The object is the exact shape claude.ai returns (see crates/meter-api/src/response.rs) — money as an {amount_minor, currency, exponent} triple with the cap nested under `cap.money`. EUR 6.40 of a EUR 2000 budget.

spend.disclaimer: Usage credits cover you when you hit your plan limits.
